about: T14, fe0797c7. 2026-10-10 OK-WW ended at 80 activity points with the 20-80 chests unclaimed and 'Daily Task Completed' logged: upstream's claim_daily clicks one fixed point, the 100 chest. The owner, 10-10 19:4x: 「鸣潮的每日为什么okww没有领，中继也不报错？」 Here every chest up to 80 must be clicked, and the 100 chest never (it has no transition). Provisional: no frame of the page at 80 exists (frames.json unrecorded daily_activity_80), so the screen is black and the claimed ticks cannot be scored; the clicks are tested, not the check's verdict. Red at fe0797c7~1: the one blind click at (0.930, 0.882) lands on the 100 chest.
